Title: Azure DevTest Labs: Public environment repository in labs

Body.Content:
We're releasing a public repository of Azure Resource Manager templates for each lab. You can use the repository to create environments without having to connect to an external GitHub source by yourself. The repository includes frequently used templates such as Azure Web Apps, Service Fabric clusters, and developer SharePoint farm environments.

To learn more about this feature, go to our team blog.
